newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street slip at open, then pull off lows.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street slip at open, then pull off lows.

text.p: U.S. shares fell in early trading on Monday as investors took profits following Friday's strong session, but then climbed back slightly.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was down around 14 points at 7,782, above an initial intraday low of 7,751.
The Nasdaq composite was up 0.55 points to 1,447 after first slipping.
Shares of Philip Morris Cos Inc came under some pressure after Friday's announcement of a landmark settlement between the tobacco industry and U.S. states.
